mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rn , x.qa_id , x.dr_id , x.qa_title , x.qa_content , x.qa_private , x.qa_answer , x.qa_answer FROM ( SELECT rv.rv_content , rv.rv_id , rv.mb_id , rv.rv_rating , rv.rv_show , dr.dr_product , dr.dr_id FROM REVIEW_TB rv JOIN DRUG_TB dr ON rv.dr_id = dr.dr_id WHERE rv.mb_id = #{mbId} ORDER BY rv.rv_id DESC ) x WHERE ROWNUM <= #{end} ) WHERE rn >= #{start}
